image_description: A young girl with long brown hair is blowing bubbles using a pink and yellow bubble wand. She is wearing a pink t-shirt with a graphic print. Several translucent soap bubbles are visible in the air around her face and wand, exhibiting iridescent colors and reflecting the background. The background consists of green grass and a blurred wooden fence.
